verdict.rationale: Pipedream workflows natively support a Schedule trigger alongside webhook/email/RSS triggers, letting users set up recurring cron-based automations, and these workflows can run arbitrary Node.js/Python/Go/Bash code with retries and error alerting for robust recurring jobs. This is documented first-party and corroborated by community use of workflows in production automation contexts. missing for 10: no explicit docs on cron syntax/frequency limits, and no independent hands-on report specifically validating scheduled (vs webhook) triggers.
